base: Black-and-white editorial vintage documentary photograph, 1960s-70s sports photojournalism, desaturated, high contrast, heavy film grain. Universe: football/soccer and athletics — stadiums, muddy pitches, players, spectators, terraces. COMPOSITION: the subject sits low, in the lower third of the frame, with foreground bleeding off the bottom edge; the ENTIRE UPPER HALF of the image is bright, pale, empty and hazy, fading to near-white at the top edge for clean compositing. No text, no words, no numbers, no logos, no emojis, no gradients, no added color, no modern stock-photo look, no digital sharpness.

images.scene: A completely empty, deserted old football stadium grandstand, clean smooth stepped rows of bare weathered concrete terracing, not a single person anywhere, silent and abandoned, misty overcast day, vintage. IMPORTANT: bare plain concrete steps only, NO metal bars, NO railings, NO crush barriers, NO fencing, nothing that looks like exercise equipment — just clean empty concrete terraces. The stand fills the lower portion and bleeds off the bottom; the pale hazy sky fills the whole upper half, empty.

Wide view of weathered concrete stadium terraces with a scattering of distant seated spectators, far from the pitch, the empty stands themselves dominating; the crowd sits in the lower half, bright pale overcast sky filling the upper half.

Two or three men in the stands leaning forward over the railing, one pointing and gesturing with his hand as he talks and criticizes, faces set in judgement, flat caps and coats, vintage terrace. They sit low in the frame; pale empty sky above.

A football player on a muddy pitch pushing himself up off the ground after a fall, one hand planted in the mud, body caked in dirt, mid-effort of rising. He is low in the frame with the churned muddy field bleeding off the bottom; the upper half is pale hazy sky.

Still-life close-up of a single pair of heavy, worn, mud-caked leather football boots resting on the churned muddy turf, laces undone, studs clogged with earth, the toll of the match. The boots sit low in the frame; the pale hazy background fills the whole upper half, empty.

A lone runner training alone at dawn on an empty athletics track, solitary silhouette in motion, disciplined and unwatched, mist over the ground. The runner is low in the frame; pale foggy empty sky fills the upper half.

A spent football player sitting on the grass after the match, drenched in sweat and mud but with his head held up, dignified and proud in exhaustion. He sits low in the frame; the bright pale sky fills the entire upper half.

A single exhausted football player walking off the pitch alone at dusk, seen from behind and to the side, shoulders heavy but upright, backlit hazy light; the emptying stadium fades pale behind him. He is low in the frame; the pale luminous upper half is empty.

An athlete pushing a heavy iron training sled / weighted roller across a muddy field, straining hard against the resistance, leaning into it, immense effort but barely moving, going nowhere. He is low in the frame with the churned muddy ground bleeding off the bottom; the upper half is bright, pale, empty and hazy.

A football coach or manager in a long overcoat standing on the touchline, instructing and directing his players with a pointing, commanding gesture, tactical and mentoring, the teacher of the game. 1960s-70s vintage. He is low in the frame; the pale hazy stadium and sky fill the whole upper half.

A lone football player seen from behind, standing on the pitch with hands on his hips, looking out toward the distant goal and the misty far stands with resolve and direction. He is small and stands LOW in the lower third of the frame; the churned pitch bleeds off the bottom and the ENTIRE upper two-thirds of the image is bright, pale, empty open sky and haze, fading to near-white at the top. Wide establishing shot, lots of empty space above him.
